name: Qi Sinew
description: Thread qi through the sinews so every pull of a muscle carries a surge of energy.

name: Qi-Loaded Fist
description: Throw a fist loaded with qi so the blow lands with both the weight and the bite of it.

name: Humming Hide
description: Run a low hum of qi under the skin so it turns edges and softens clubs.

name: Vein Surge
description: Drive qi along the veins in a single rush that doubles the speed of the next three moves.

name: Flesh Lantern
description: Light the body with qi from within and feel the whole room through the skin.

name: Dense Lash
description: Whip a limb heavy with condensed qi through the target's guard.

name: Bone Plating
description: Plate the bones with hardened qi so a blow must break the plate before it reaches the frame.

name: Meridian Mend
description: Run qi down the torn channels of yourself or an ally and knit flesh and meridian together.

name: Wrought Impact
description: Throw the qi-wrought frame into the foe and loose the stored force in a heavy ring about it.

name: Body-Qi Eclipse
description: streams: Body + Qi; weld body and qi into one mass that strikes and guards in the same instant.

name: Core Hide
description: Feed the hide from the Core so it stays hard and does not tire.

name: Loaded Fist
description: Throw a fist weighted with Core qi that lands with the mass of a boulder.

name: Dense Step
description: Stride with the weight of the Core underfoot and cover ground without a sway.

name: Lattice Breath
description: Breathe so that Core qi settles into the muscle fibres in an even net.

name: Core Hammer
description: Drop a blow from the shoulder with a pulse of Core qi arriving in the fist.

name: Wrought Guard
description: Throw up the forearm hardened by the Core and turn a heavy cut aside.

name: Marrow Bloom
description: Wake the marrow with Core warmth and mend the bone of yourself or an ally from within.

name: Rot Burn-Off
description: Burn rot and taint from the flesh of yourself or an ally with controlled Core heat.

name: Quaking Step
description: Stamp down with the weight of the Core and leap into the foe along the shaken ground.

name: Dense Aegis
description: Wrap the body in a field of Core qi so thick that blows slow before they land.

name: Heavenwrought Fist
description: Compress the Core into a fist and strike through the hardest armor into what it guards.

name: Flesh Core Convergence
description: streams: Body + Qi; fuse flesh and Core in one blow whose weight and force break the ground.

name: Soul Weight
description: Settle soul force into the limbs so their weight feels doubled behind each blow.

name: Spirit Fist
description: Throw a fist that lands first on the body and a breath later on the spirit behind it.

name: Presence Guard
description: Throw out the presence of the soul in front of the body to blunt a blow before it lands.

name: Weighted Stride
description: Step with the weight of the soul added to the foot so the ground shakes.

name: Anchored Frame
description: Anchor the body with the soul so no push can move it from its place.

name: Soul-Laden Blow
description: Hit with the body while the soul presses the target down by weight and fear.

name: Soul Warmth
description: Pour the warmth of the soul into the body of yourself or an ally and close its hurts.

name: Spirit Reading
description: Feel the soul of the person before you through the weight of its body.

name: Incarnate Pressure
description: Bear down with the weight of body and soul together until the foe cannot lift a limb.

name: Soul Erosion Cleanse
description: Draw the damage of a soul wound out through the body of yourself or an ally.

name: Embodied Strike
description: Gather body and soul into one fist and throw a blow that carries the whole person.

name: Physicalized Spirit
description: Let soul force take the weight of flesh and hammer the ground with it.

name: Flesh-Spirit Union
description: streams: Body + Soul; unite flesh and spirit in one blow that crushes the body and shakes the soul.

name: Vessel Stance
description: Stand as an open vessel with soul force held in the frame and hold it against pushes.

name: Container Fist
description: Throw a blow that carries a measure of stored soul force out through the fist.

name: Weight Breath
description: Breathe slowly into the chest and let the soul sink into the weight of the limbs.

name: Print-Free Step
description: Step so softly that the body leaves no print and arrives before its shadow.

name: Externalized Guard
description: Pour soul force out around the frame as a pale shell that stops a blow short.

name: Soul Rattle
description: Strike the body and rattle the soul so the foe's focus breaks.

name: Rooted Spirit
description: Root the soul in the legs and bones and let its calm steady each blow you throw.

name: Spirit Knitting
description: Knit the flesh of yourself or an ally from the soul outward and ease the pain.

name: Undying Frame
description: Let the soul's permanence spread into flesh and bone so they resist ruin.

name: Surge Palm
description: Send a surge of soul force through an open palm and into the foe's body.

name: Resolute Body
description: Cast out curse and soul erosion from the frame of yourself or an ally.

name: Crowning Mass
description: Bring the full presence of body and soul down on the foe to crush its will to fight.

name: Bodied Soul
description: streams: Body + Soul; hurl the soul out through the frame as a blow of physical force that shatters stone.

name: Unbroken Vessel
description: streams: Body + Soul; hold the body whole against ruin with soul force and mend it as it is struck.
